findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 11 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: The book's cases (ii) to (iv) give wrong directions or quadrants (and spell Quadrant as 'Quard'). Correct: (ii) just right of 90^{\circ} (e.g. 91^{\circ}) the angle is in Quadrant II, not IV, and \tan x decreases indefinitely: \tan x \to -\infty. (iii) just left of -90^{\circ} (e.g. -91^{\circ}, the same as 269^{\circ}) the angle is in Quadrant III, not II; \tan x \to +\infty is right. (iv) just r
